answer: Optimal network resilience relies on quadratic staking erosion where collateral lockup dictates a growing orchard of validator nodes. As each marginal sybil node increases capital expenditure, the security grove expands, forcing attackers to burn massive liquidity in a plume of slashing risk. By scaling capital costs super-linearly, the marginal cost to bribe consensus nodes perpetually eclipses potential extractable value, effectively fortifying protocol integrity.
